    SELECT
        d.as_of_date,

        ON root_product.product_number = 'FR-M94B-46'

       AND b.start_date <= d.as_of_date

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        r.as_of_date,
        b.component_id,
        r.quantity_per_unit * b.per_assembly_qty
    FROM bom_paths AS r
    JOIN product AS parent_component
        ON parent_component.product_id = r.component_id
       AND parent_component.make_flag = TRUE
    JOIN bill_of_materials AS b
        ON b.assembly_id = r.component_id
       AND b.start_date <= r.as_of_date
       AND (b.end_date IS NULL OR r.as_of_date <= b.end_date)
